answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities bleed money. Like rain into karst limestone, the fee drains away for good: each agent pays a 60 POA tax to claim one knoll in the market, and the tax is burned, never refunded. That payment is a costly signal: an honest agent pays once and earns it back from real work, while an attacker minting 1,000 fakes burns 60,000 POA before earning a cent. Rented identities still pay full tax, so cost scales with attack.
